item.text: I’ll trace the comment, mention, notification, and search paths, then update the implementation to match the reported behavior.

The main problems are in the shared service and thread assembly: mentions are capped and filtered, alerts overlap, and nested or deleted comments are dropped. I’m updating those paths together so stored data and notifications stay consistent.
